question: By selling an article for ₹ 7,281, a man loses 10%. At what price (in ₹) should he sell it in order to make a profit of 10%?
solution:
**Given:**

By selling an article for ₹ 7,281, a man loses 10%

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price × (100 + profit)%

Selling price = Cost price × (100 - loss)%

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the article be Rs. x

According to the question,

x × (90/100) = 7281

⇒ x = 7281 × (10/9)

⇒ x = 8090

Now,

Selling price to get a profit of 10% = 8090 &t
imes; (110/100)

⇒ 8899

**∴ He should sell it in 8899 (in ₹) order to make a profit of 10%.**
